cluster.headline: הניתוח שחושף את הקשר בין מחיר הדירה שלכם - לפתק ששמתם בקלפי
cluster.note: Paywalled; only subhead/intro visible (re-fetched 2026-10-29, byline Simi Spolter, 28 Oct 2026 18:22). Visible claims: cross-referenced 26th Knesset results at 9,224 polling stations with apartment prices; higher-priced neighborhoods correlate with stronger support for the change bloc; Likud stronger in cheaper neighborhoods; Yisrael Beiteinu exception; trend lines meet around NIS 19,000/sqm. No methodology (price source, matching method, regression type) visible.
